commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot to Bill and add greeting
Add support for echoing user input
Add support for storing and listing tasks
Add support for updating task status
Introduce Task model and chatbot helper commands
Refactor Bill to follow coding standard
commitResults.messageBody: Bill's main method handles several distinct responsibilities, which makes the command flow difficult to scan and extend. Extract focused helper methods and named constants so future commands can follow the SE-EDU coding conventions consistently.
Represent todos, deadlines, and events as task subtypes so each task can share completion behaviour while displaying its own type and timing details.

Move todo, deadline, and event parsing out of Bill so the chatbot interaction flow is not coupled to delimiter and substring details. This gives parsing and future validation one focused location without changing user-visible behaviour.

Make Task abstract and require each concrete subtype to provide its own type icon. This prevents accidentally creating an unclassified generic task and makes the model's three supported task types explicit.

Validate todo, deadline, and event syntax before creating tasks. Report specific, recoverable errors for missing descriptions or time markers and reject unknown commands so invalid input cannot corrupt the task list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prevent crashes from invalid task operations
commitResults.messageBody: Validate mark and unmark numbers, enforce the task-list capacity, recognise delimiters only as complete tokens, and handle whitespace and end-of-input safely. Invalid commands now leave Bill running with its task state unchanged.
Integrate comprehensive, exception-based input validation while preserving the Level-5 development history as a dedicated branch.

Group the application entry point, parser, exception, and task model by responsibility while retaining src/main/java as the source root. Update the README launch path to match the packaged Bill class.
Integrate the package organization while retaining its development as a distinct increment branch.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor Bill into focused OOP components

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and display ISO deadline dates
commitResults.messageBody: Store yyyy-MM-dd deadlines as LocalDate, show a reader-friendly date, and preserve older free-form deadline and event values. Add tests for validation and persistence.
Introduce a find command that searches descriptions case-insensitively without changing saved tasks, and cover matches and edge cases with CLI tests.
